Turns all sound off or on at once. The M key does the same.
Игра в окне или на весь экран. Переключи: Play in a window or full screen. F11 or Alt+Enter also switches.
The size the game draws its picture at. Smaller runs faster on a slow computer, larger looks sharper. “Auto” picks it from your screen.
Свечение, искры, пыль и другие частицы д: Glow, sparks, dust and other decorative particles. Turn them off if they distract you or the game is slow.

Игра читает вслух всё на экране: пункты,: The game reads everything on screen aloud — items, steps, hints — for blind and low-vision players. It speaks through your screen reader or the system voice. F2 turns it on or off.

Текст появляется сразу целиком, без печа: Text appears all at once instead of being typed letter by letter.

Клиент говорит одну фразу при входе и да: The client says one line on arrival and then stays quiet — less text on screen.
Barty the ghost and his jokes in the workshop. Turn him off if he distracts you. In the Guild, Brenna still gives hints.
Крупнее текст на всех экранах. Каждое на: Bigger text on every screen. Each press switches to the next size.
Шрифт Atkinson Hyperlegible для слабого: The Atkinson Hyperlegible font for low vision: letters and digits are easy to tell apart. English only.
Управление одной кнопкой: пункты сами по: One-button (switch) control: items light up one by one; press to choose, hold to go back. The number is seconds per item.

Хомут замка: ослабить (не выкручивать) д: Wheel-lock clamp: loosen (don't remove) the two screws with a 3/16" hex key, slide it, tighten. Adjust only on an inflated tire; the engaged shoe must press at least 3/16" (≈5 mm) into the tire.
Давление проверять каждую неделю, норма: Check the pressure every week; the right value is printed on the tire sidewall. On a soft tire the locks slip.
После любой регулировки весь крепёж затя: After any adjustment, tighten all fasteners before riding.
Угол спинки — гайка 13 мм с внутренней с: Backrest angle: 13 mm nut on the inside of the rear-wheel mount. Loosen it on one post, set the angle, tighten, then the other post; compare the post-to-armrest-plate distance on both sides.
После любой регулировки проверить антиоп: After any adjustment, check the anti-tippers work and are latched.
В отпущенном виде штифт тормоза — в 15–2: Released, the lock pin sits 15–20 mm from the tire; screw about 5 N·m. How well the lock holds depends on tire pressure.
Антиопрокидыватели — 38–51 мм (1½–2\") о: Anti-tippers: 38–51 mm (1½–2") above the floor, both exactly at the same height, moved with the push button. Above 51 mm they may not hold; below 38 mm they catch.
Ослабить контргайку, вращать регулятор,: Loosen the locknut and turn the adjuster until the slack is gone: the plunger pin must fully retract and fully seat in the rocker. Then tighten the locknut.
Оба курка вместе отпускают наклон, отпус: Both triggers together release the tilt; let go and the rockers lock. Don't tilt further than the backrest parallel to the floor.
Давление по таблице: шина 22\" — 65 psi: Pressure from the table: 22" tire — 65 psi (448 kPa).
Контргайку отпускают ключами 10 мм и 3/8: Loosen the locknut with 10 mm and 3/8" wrenches. Turn the adjuster until the slack is gone, but keep the lock tooth fully in the teeth. A kinked cable, or one that won't adjust, is replaced.
Зуб чиркает или у курка люфт — регулятор: Tooth scraping or trigger play — back the adjuster out; tooth out of mesh — screw it in. Tighten only the locknut.
Нельзя оставлять человека в кресле с кур: Never leave a person in the chair with the triggers locked open. The trigger is locked with the pin on a lanyard.
Код на пульте, звук — и коляска выключае: A code on the joystick, a beep — and the chair switches off. Codes: 01 armrest, 02 joystick not centred at power-on, 03 brakes, 04 charging, 05 battery ≤20%, 10 seat cable communication.
Джойстику хватает усилия около 1 Н — пит: The joystick needs only about 1 N of force — switch the power on without touching it.
Перед поездкой рычаги разблокировки торм: Before riding, the brake release levers must be up — brakes locked.
Рычаг подлокотника ходит туго — в основа: Armrest lever stiff — dust in its base: clean it out with a brush or an air duster.
Свободный ход — только на ровном месте,: Freewheel only on level ground, joystick off, a helper present. On the F5 both levers DOWN = freewheel, UP = drive.
Сначала выключить пульт, потом главный а: Switch off the joystick first, then the main circuit breaker. Reset the breaker once; if it trips again, call service.
Хранить в сухом месте не холоднее +5 °C,: Store dry and no colder than +5 °C, or the batteries won't charge fully. Before long storage, charge and switch off the main breaker.
Гнездо зарядки — на пульте. Зарядку подк: The charging socket is on the joystick. Plug the charger into the chair first, then the wall.
Ведущие шины — 250 кПа; проверять раз в: Drive tires 250 kPa; check every week and after temperature changes.
Кнопка key 2 сразу открывает экран сиден: Key 2 opens the seat screen directly. Lockout indicator: green — no limits, yellow — the lift has limited speed, red — locked out.
iLevel работает, только если наклон и от: iLevel works only with seat tilt and recline at 20° or less. Raise the seat only on a level floor indoors and keep the area around the scissors clear.
Все разъёмы — плотные, закреплённые, без: All connectors tight, secured and free of corrosion. A cracked connector or a chafed harness — take it to a Quantum dealer.
Главный автомат — на батарейном лотке по: The main circuit breaker is on the battery tray under the rear cover; the cover comes off without tools.
Настраивают, когда человек сидит: ладонь: Adjust with the person seated: hand under the lowest pelvic bone, let air out until your fingers can just move — 1.5–2.5 cm of air under the pelvis (about one finger).
Высота сиденья — перестановкой колёс: 47: Seat height comes from wheel positions: 470 mm — axle in holes 1+2, forks in A; 500 mm — 2+3 and B; 530 mm — 3+4 and C. The top hole of the plate is for the drum brake.
Регулировка: отпустить тормоз, ослабить: Adjusting: release the lock, loosen the bolts, slide it along the rail toward the wheel, tighten, test with a push. These are parking locks — not for braking while moving.
Колесо снимают при отпущенных тормозах:: Remove the wheel with the locks released: push the button in the centre of the hub.
После перестановки вилка должна стоять о: After moving the wheels, the fork must stand vertical to the floor.
Тормоз сдвигают по рейке ключом 12 мм. В: Slide the lock along the rail with a 12 mm wrench. Engaged, the shoe presses about 4 mm into the tire — the same on both sides.
Два шестигранника 4 мм; почистить проста: Two 4 mm hex keys; clean the spacers, wipe the bearings, one drop of oil each. The bolt thread should keep its threadlocker — otherwise use a new bolt or mild threadlocker.
После песка, соли или дождя быстросъёмну: After sand, salt water or rain, put a drop of oil on the quick-release axle.
Давление — 8 бар (800 кПа). На мягкой ши: Pressure 8 bar (800 kPa). On a soft tire the lock won't hold.
Застрял — не держи джойстик дольше неско: Stuck? Don't hold the joystick for more than a few seconds — the motors overheat. Don't drive into water or swamps.
Разное давление тянет коляску вбок. На б: Unequal pressure pulls the chair to one side. Off-road up to 8 psi, 24 psi maximum; check weekly.
Гайки колёс X8 затягивают с усилием 47–5: X8 wheel nuts are tightened to 47–50 N·m.
Все огоньки мигают белым и 4 сигнала — т: All lights flashing white plus 4 beeps — charging temperature outside 0–40 °C, charging stopped. Charge at 0–40 °C with both wheels switched off.
У колёс e-motion нет своих тормозов: при: E-motion wheels have no brakes of their own: when charging or parked, engage the wheelchair's wheel locks.
Гнездо зарядки — магнитное, на кнопке ст: The charging socket is magnetic, on the hub button; clean it with a dry cloth, nothing metal. Don't press the push rims while charging.
Автомат выбивает при перегрузке: подожда: The breaker trips under overload: wait about a minute, press the button, switch on the joystick. If it trips again and again — Pride service.
Предел веса — вместе со всем, что на кол: The weight limit includes everything on the chair: Jazzy 614 — 136 kg (300 lb), 614 HD — 204 kg.
Нет питания — проверить разъёмы жгутов,: No power — check the harness connectors, the breaker and the battery terminals.
У деталей с книжкой есть сноска из мануа: Parts with a book icon have a manual footnote — hover over the part.
Обод гуляет на 2–3 мм — лёгкая «восьмёрк: The rim wobbles by 2–3 mm — a slight wobble out of true.
Включи коляску кнопкой на пульте и легон: Switch the chair on with the joystick's power button and push the joystick gently: all the electric brakes should click.
Еженедельная проверка из мануала (§7.17): A weekly check from the manual (§7.17): on a level floor with a metre of clear space around.
Включи зарядку в розетку, потом вставь ш: Plug the charger into the wall, then put the plug into the socket on the hub button: the magnet snaps it into place.
Действуй по блок-схеме: открути торцевым: Follow the flowchart: unbolt it with a socket wrench and replace the motor/brake assembly
